No dependency among A, B, C was visible; none is needed. No hop was pre-solved.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the extension": quoting on the unposted ledger breaks all three sentences and gives 80.86 x 128.25 x 0.07 x 0.54 = 392.00.
- Service-visit reading of SB-2310275 excluded by the delivery-window rule (opened day 0); installation minutes by billable minutes (255) excluded by the Staged tier ("whatever the ticket's billable minutes").
- Size rate 135.00 as hour value excluded by tier 2 of the valuation schedule (invoiced 20520.00 below list 21600.00).
- Size percentage 7.5 excluded by the 30-59 day early-signing tier; standing point applies on top ("A 6 percent fee percentage with 1 point becomes 7 percent").
- Tenure-free loyalty: renewal_count 4 >= 1 on Professional -> 0.75 (not 0.5, which is Premier/Enterprise).
- Older project dates (10-08, 10-05 ...) already drawn; only 2026-10-15 is "most recently dated".

### Openness noted (policy-side note, not a document verdict)
- The KB states "extended by the size's extension months" without a month-arithmetic rule for the new expiry date; both natural readings coincide here (2027-06-08).
